name: Tool-Genesis
description: Tool-Genesis is a diagnostic benchmark designed to evaluate self-evolving language agents on their ability to autonomously create, adapt, and maintain tools from abstract task requirements. It measures interface compliance, functional correctness, and downstream utility to identify specific failure causes in tool synthesis.
reputation: A very recent diagnostic benchmark with limited community adoption so far, primarily of interest for agent/tool-synthesis research.
notes: Emphasizes evaluation without preset specifications and highlights challenges in one-shot tool interface and logic generation.
